name: Benign explicit empty POSITIVE Resource set (must NOT be flagged)
note: S1-shape-failclosed no-over-fire control. An explicit empty POSITIVE Resource set (Resource:[]) is PRESENT and matches NO resource, so the Allow grants nothing - the resource twin of the benign Action:[] set. It must never be flagged as UNSPECIFIED_RESOURCE_SCOPE (that shape is Resource key ABSENT). Pins the resourcePresent presence-flag distinction so the model does not conflate Resource:[] with an omitted Resource.
